question.en: Discuss the significance of the Human Development Report in shaping social sector policies in India.
question.hi: Discuss the significance of the Human Development Report in shaping social sector policies in India.

modelAnswer.en: The HDR provides a comparative framework for India to assess its progress in health, education, and income. It highlights gaps in human capital formation, prompting policy interventions like the National Health Mission and Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan to improve HDI rankings.
